note: Free OFFICIAL sources for 'who owns this land?' (SOTA Summit Checker). map = a statewide parcel map that shows owners free (url may hold {lat} {lon}); list = the state's official directory of county assessor / PVA offices. Anything else: a .gov-only search for the county assessor. Never paid sites. Sources checked Oct 24 2026 (official .gov / state university pages); not listed = no free official statewide source found (HI and NJ maps hide owner names by law).
